title: BigP3BCI Study L — 6x6 multi-paradigm (11 ALS subjects)
description: This dataset contains EEG recordings from 11 participants with amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) performing a P300-based brain-computer interface speller task with a 6x6 character grid (Study L of the BigP3BCI collection). Data were recorded from 16 EEG channels at 256 Hz with a g.USBamp amplifier. Target and non-target flashes are annotated with HED tags. The dataset is a BIDS derivative of the BigP3BCI collection on PhysioNet, prepared for benchmarking with MOABB.
methods_description: EEG was recorded from 16 channels in a standard 10-20 montage using a g.USBamp (g.tec) at 256 Hz, with 60 Hz line frequency. Participants performed a P300 speller task with a 6x6 grid and online feedback in a laboratory setting. A calibration-then-test scheme was used, with events labelled Target and NonTarget.
